title: Finite Elements for Helmholtz Scattering with Infinity as a Computational Boundary
summary: Building on the null-infinity-layer construction, we develop an H1-conforming finite-element formulation of hyperboloidal compactification for the exterior Helmholtz equation. A change of coordinates maps infinity to a finite outer boundary, and a rescaling removes the leading oscillatory decay. We derive the transformed equation and a global sesquilinear weak formulation with bounded coefficients.
